    • use

      public void use(double accumulateDeltaTime)
      Description copied from class: Weapon
      Ticks the weapon each game frame while it is in the equipped weapon slot.

      Implementations should increment Weapon.timeSinceUse by accumulateDeltaTime and fire (spawning a projectile in GameManager.getUsingWeaponList()) when the cooldown elapses.

      Specified by:
      use in class Weapon
      Parameters:
      accumulateDeltaTime - seconds since the last frame

    • update

      public void update(double accumulateDeltaTime)
      Description copied from class: Weapon
      Advances the state of an active projectile / effect that was already spawned.

      After Weapon.use(double) creates and adds a weapon instance to usingWeaponList, the game loop calls update() on it every frame until Weapon.isExpired() returns true.

      Specified by:
      update in interface Updatable
      Specified by:
      update in class Weapon
      Parameters:
      accumulateDeltaTime - seconds since the last frame

    • decreaseCooldown

      public void decreaseCooldown(double multiplier)
      Description copied from interface: CooldownDecreasable
      Multiplies the weapon's current cooldown by the given factor.

      A multiplier of 0.9 reduces the cooldown by 10 %. Values above 1.0 would lengthen the cooldown; accessories should always pass values in (0, 1].

      Specified by:
      decreaseCooldown in interface CooldownDecreasable
      Parameters:
      multiplier - factor applied to the current cooldown (e.g. 0.9)

    • increaseDamage

      public void increaseDamage(double multiplier)
      Description copied from interface: DamageIncreasable
      Multiplies the weapon's current damage output by the given factor.

      A multiplier of 1.1 represents a 10 % increase. Implementations should clamp or document any upper bound they impose.

      Specified by:
      increaseDamage in interface DamageIncreasable
      Parameters:
      multiplier - the factor to apply (e.g. 1.1 for +10 %)
